ios.desc:
Tokki is a messenger where your conversations slowly transform into the language you're learning.

HOW IT WORKS                                                                                                                                      
Chat with friends like you normally would. When you learn a new word, add it to your shared vocabulary. From that moment on, that word automatically replaces itself in every message — yours and theirs. You read, you understand, you learn. No textbooks, no drills.                  

TAP ANY WORD
Don't know how to pronounce a word? Tap it. Tokki plays the native pronunciation instantly. Every word in your vocabulary becomes a word you can say out loud.                                                                                                                                   

QUIZ YOUR VOCABULARY
Tokki generates quizzes from the words you and your friends actually use. Complete 10-question rounds, earn fun titles like Word Wizard or Vocab Star, and compete on the chat leaderboard. Share your results and challenge your friends to beat your score.                                    
                                                                                                                                                    
  FEATURES                                                  
  - Smart word replacement — learned words auto-replace in messages                                                                                 
  - Tap-to-pronounce — hear native pronunciation for any word      
  - Vocabulary quizzes with leaderboards and streaks                                                                                                
  - Import vocabulary between chats                                                                                                                 
  - Real-time messaging with typing indicators and push notifications                                                                               
  - Swipe to reply                                                                                                                                  
  - Group chats and private conversations                                                                                                           
  - Progress tracking — words learned, messages sent, daily streaks
  - Dark mode
